title: Ranked - Beta Season 9
headline: A new ranked season with a softer reset.
reset: Ranks soft reset by about 1 badge on average.
Last season's winrate adjusts placement by 1-2 subranks.

rules.label: Rank loss shields (full rank)
rules.note: Phantom, Ascendant and Eternus have no shields at all.

rules.label: Per-season leaderboard
rules.note: Must play within the last 30 days.

takeaways: Most players start about one badge lower.
Leaderboard hopefuls need 50 ranked matches a month.
